mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 0.5% is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% in 1 month is followed by negative 5-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases) is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 2 consecutive months is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
